name: procedural-shuttle-capacity-v1

generator.visibility: entire blurred shuttle support inside image; otherwise absent
generator.background: uint8 median of all24 generated RGB frames, not clean plate

variants.decoder: two up_block_3 convolution weights and predictor weight/bias;4 tensors
variants.convolution: all17 convolution weights and predictor weight/bias;19 tensors

training.normalization: eval mode; BN affine parameters and buffers frozen
training.loss: 0.5*mean support squared error +0.5*mean complement squared error; empty set zero
training.selection: minimum mean validation chunk loss, earliest epoch on ties

evaluation.synthetic_test: all24 frames/group, overlapping ensemble; both selections sealed before test generation
evaluation.familiar_sources: 50 complete views,13499 rows,60 cases; diagnostics only

limitations: Generated geometry is procedural truth, not expert badminton supervision.
Familiar source diagnostics cannot select or tune weights or establish independent accuracy.
No source eligibility, installed model, application defaults or complete-reference claim changes.
